name: google-workspace-unlimited
description: Google Workspace MCP server (Gmail, Drive, Docs, Sheets, Slides, Calendar, Forms, Chat, Photos, Contacts) bundled with skills for the card/email DSL, code mode, and Qdrant search over past tool responses.

google_client_id.title: Google OAuth client ID
google_client_id.description: OAuth 2.0 client ID from Google Cloud Console. Only needed before your first authentication flow; leave blank if you use a client secrets file instead.

google_client_secret.title: Google OAuth client secret
google_client_secret.description: OAuth 2.0 client secret paired with the client ID above. Only needed before your first authentication flow.

google_client_secrets_file.title: Google client secrets file (alternative)
google_client_secrets_file.description: Path to the OAuth client JSON downloaded from Google Cloud Console. Alternative to entering the client ID and secret directly.
